messages.subject: Project Aquilo - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin, Rebecca,

Attached is our draft of the Heads of Terms for the Calderwater framework (internal reference "Project Aquilo"). Key points for you to confirm before we send to Calderwater:

- Minimum annual commitment from Calderwater: £3.5m (ex VAT)
- Shortfall: we've put Harrow's opening position at 15% of any shortfall
- Term: 5 years + 2x 12-month extensions
- Confidentiality and a 60-day exclusivity period are drafted as binding; the rest is subject to contract

Let me know if the commercials look right.

Best,

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0048
whitfieldcarter.com
